summary: ZTO Express, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing only the date of an upcoming board meeting. No specific terms, stake, price, premium, or any transactional details are provided. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics disclosed. The filing is a routine notification of a board meeting, not a special situation. As a non-US filing, this Form 6-K serves the same purpose as a US Form 8-K for announcing a board meeting date. There is no risk arbitrage angle to watch; it is purely procedural.
